name: Deep Research Agent Skill
tagline: Multi-source research reports your agent writes for you
description: Install a research analyst into your coding agent. Deep Research Agent Skill plans an inquiry, fans out across sources, scores evidence quality, and compiles a cited report — all from a single prompt inside Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
features: Auto-triggers on research intents via SKILL.md bootstrap
Source fan-out with credibility scoring and deduplication
Citation ledger with quote-level provenance
Structured report output: TL;DR, findings, caveats, next steps
Eval suite with 12 graded research scenarios
includes: Eval suite (12 scenarios with deterministic checks)

faqs.a: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and any harness that scans a skills/ directory. Install by dropping the folder in and restarting.
It uses your agent's existing web tools. If none are present, it degrades gracefully to local-file research.

faqs.q: How is this different from a prompt?
faqs.a: A skill shapes behavior across sessions: it auto-loads, follows a tested workflow, and self-checks against evals before declaring done.

name: Code Review Sentinel
tagline: PR review skill that catches bugs before merge
description: A senior-reviewer behavior for your agent: scans diffs for correctness bugs, security smells, and performance traps, then posts review comments ranked by severity with suggested patches. Ships with a red-flags table organized around common review concerns.
features: Severity-ranked findings with inline suggested patches
Red-flags table concept organized around common review concerns
Security smells detector (authz, injection, secrets, deps)
Diff-aware: reviews only what changed, with file context
Eval suite with 20 seeded PRs and known findings

faqs.a: No — it advises. Findings are ranked so you can gate on 'critical' in your CI if you choose.
Yes. Point any agent at the PR diff; the skill formats output as review comments.
Best on TypeScript, Python, Go, and Ruby; pattern table covers JS/TS most deeply.

name: SEO Auditor Skill
tagline: Site audits your agent runs on demand
description: Turn your agent into an SEO auditor. It crawls sitemaps, checks Core Web Vitals signals, validates structured data, and produces a prioritized fix-list with the exact code edits to apply.
features: Sitemap crawl with broken-link and redirect-chain detection
Structured-data validator for Product, Article, FAQ schemas
Meta and heading hierarchy audit with rewrite suggestions
Prioritized fix-list: impact × effort scoring
Eval suite with 10 seeded sites

faqs.a: It is designed for focused audits on small-to-mid sites; large crawls are better handled alongside a dedicated crawler.
Yes — findings ship as actionable edits your agent can implement after your approval.

faqs.q: How often should I run it?
faqs.a: Weekly for active sites; the skill tracks delta against the previous run.

name: Content Repurposer Skill
tagline: One asset in, ten formats out
description: Atomize any long-form asset into a campaign: threads, carousels, short videos, newsletters, and ad angles — each with platform-native formatting and a 30-day distribution calendar.
features: 1-to-10 atomization: blog → thread, carousel, script, email, ads
Platform-native formatters for X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube
Hook extractor that finds the 5 sharpest angles in any piece
30-day distribution calendar generator
Eval suite with 8 seeded assets

faqs.a: Paste text, a URL your agent can fetch, or point it at a local file — Markdown, HTML, or transcript.
Yes — a voice-lock step samples your writing first and constrains every output to it.

name: Data Viz Craftsman Skill
tagline: Charts your agent designs, not just renders
description: A design critic for your charts. The skill selects the right chart type, enforces a visual hierarchy, applies accessible color scales, and outputs production-ready SVG or Canvas code.
features: Chart-type recommender based on data shape and question
Accessible palettes (colorblind-safe, WCAG AA contrast)
Code output for D3, Chart.js, Recharts, and native SVG
Annotation layer: callouts, trend lines, and highlights
Eval suite with 10 datasets and target visuals

faqs.a: D3, Chart.js, Recharts, ECharts, and plain SVG — pick your stack and the skill codes to it.

faqs.q: Does it handle time series well?
faqs.a: Yes, including dual-axis guidance and seasonality annotations.
It's designed for them — multiple charts get consistent scales and a shared legend system.

name: Email Outreach Operative
tagline: Cold email skill with reply-rate instincts
description: A cold-email specialist living inside your agent. It researches prospects, writes sequences with spacing logic, compares subject-line options, and drafts polite follow-ups that respect reply signals.
features: Prospect research brief from a single LinkedIn or company URL
3-touch sequence generator with timing logic
Subject-line A/B pack with predicted-open reasoning
Reply-aware follow-up drafts (detects positive signals)
Spam-trigger scanner on every draft

faqs.a: No — it drafts. You send through your provider, keeping deliverability in your control.
Drafts include opt-out lines and legitimate-interest notes; the checklist covers EU/UK/BR/ID bases.
Three touches by default, with an optional fourth for enterprise plays.

name: Localization Ninja Skill
description: Localization that goes beyond translation: the skill adapts idioms, currencies, date formats, imagery cues, and compliance language per market. Ships with locale packs for EN, ID, PT-BR, ES, FR, DE, JA, and ZH.
features: 8 locale packs with idiom and register guidance
Cultural adaptation notes per string (not just words)
Format localization: dates, numbers, currencies, units
Legal copy adapters for GDPR, LGPD, and PDP Law
Eval suite with 12 mistranslation traps

faqs.a: The core handles text; for RTL layout it emits CSS logical-property guidance for your agent to apply.

faqs.q: Can it localize my codebase strings?
faqs.a: Yes — point it at your i18n JSON/PO files and it fills target locales while preserving keys.
It's a first-pass accelerator, not a replacement. The eval suite flags high-risk strings for human review.

name: Test Author Agent
tagline: Unit and e2e tests your agent writes with you
description: A TDD partner for your agent: analyzes functions, writes unit tests with edge-case hunting, generates Playwright e2e flows, and measures coverage deltas — then refactors tests for readability.
features: Edge-case hunter: boundary, null, race, and idempotency tests
Playwright e2e flow generator from user stories
Coverage delta report after every run
Test readability refactor pass (AAA structure)
Eval suite with 15 buggy fixtures

faqs.a: Jest/Vitest, pytest, Go testing, RSpec, and Playwright — the skill detects your stack from config files.
Yes, if your agent has shell access; otherwise it hands you the files.
